We have been noticing a few issues on the sub recently. Some are becoming problems, others are things we need to clarify for new players.

Unrealistic posts

You are allowed to bend realism slightly on this sub. It would not be as fun if that wasn't the case. However, we will invalidate posts or ask you to make alterations if something is too unrealistic, as we do need some consistency to make the game playable. We have been having problems with players not accepting these invalidations and alterations and it is starting to get to the point where it is draining too much of our time debating over posts with players. We are available to discuss posts with and you are allowed to make your case for why a post should be allowed if you have the research to back it up, but if you are arguing with multiple moderators as to why we are all wrong, you are wasting everyone's time. Being abusive to moderators when we tell you why we have to invalidate a post and then being surprised when we are less than civil in response will not be tolerated anymore.

Research your posts

Please try to at least do some research. If you make posts that do not have any sources then the moderators have to do the research to figure out whether the posts are acceptable or not, which is time consuming. We do not mind researching occasionally, but if we have multiple posts that need to be checked and there are only 1-2 moderators online, it is a lot of work. Add a link to your post to back it up.

Player inactivity

There have been recent issues regarding inactive players. We will kick you if you are inactive for too long. Our claims sheet will be updated soon and each country will have a minimum number of posts per week assigned to it. If you are going to be away for a while, message @laceface or one of the other mods to let them know.

Rolling for posts

Posts can only be rolled for by moderators. There have been a couple of incidents where players have rolled by themselves, we can't allow that, even if someone else acts as a witness. If your post hasn't been rolled for, drop by in the IRC and link your post there, a mod will roll for you.

New claimants

We would like to remind new claimants that you need to fill out the claim form located on the sidebar before you make a claim post for a country.

Expectations of moderators

We do this for fun. We enjoy this community and that is why we devote our time to it, but we can not be here 24/7. Sometimes it might take us a while to roll for your post, we might miss a roll post altogether and you'll need to tag a mod in the comments or PM us. At times we may be busy doing something on the sub and be unable to answer a question in the IRC, or we might make a decision that is flawed. All of us are normal people and have obligations outside of the sub. We do welcome criticism and questions but please remember we can't be perfect.
I think I can speak for everyone on this Sub, We appreciate everything the mods do.
